instruction: In qamstack/index.html, the FAQ answer to "What does it cost?" begins "The tools are free and open source." Make that first sentence "The tools are free and open source, under the MIT licence." and keep the rest of the answer. Change nothing else.

require.match: The tools are free and open source, under the MIT licence\. Self-hosting the memory server costs whatever the machine costs\. There is a hosted service if you would rather not run one\.
